scope: Isolated task-specific resident, one Linux host simulating three voters and two replica signers, a single Mac mini and a temporary authenticated SSH transport. The short diagnostic was not a resident turn. Test model services, tunnel and test voters were stopped and ephemeral credentials cleared. No fleet scheduling or independent fault tolerance was qualified. The resident binary used in the attempted turn was composed from an earlier profile-recovery source and lacked the latest interrupted-output retry fix; later native gates use the exact current integrated source.

compactDiagnostic.source: Shortened operator-prepared work order and snapshot; full pinned SOUL and previous proposal preserved. A direct model diagnostic, not an admitted resident turn.
